text_to_image_prompt: One compact tropical oceanfront flat-roof white villa to the right of a single long rectangular cyan infinity pool. Ocean to left; circular sunken lounge with cream cushions and round fire bowl at far short end; narrow stone paths; straight floating wood exterior stair at near end of villa; small wooden bar with three wicker stools at near-right. Teak roof has white daybed, brass telescope, slim dark/glass railings. No people, second pool or extra wings. Portrait architectural reference board on white, two large vertically stacked orthographic colored elevations: long pool-facing elevation with glass sliding doors above and short stair-facing elevation below. Four small material swatches: white plaster, teak, cream limestone, dark-framed glass. Fine crisp lines, subtle realistic material rendering. No labels or measurements. Concept set design reference, not measured construction documentation.
original_prompt: The first input is the spatial master of the SAME compact tropical villa. Strictly preserve its topology: one long rectangular infinity pool left, single rectangular white villa right, circular sunken cream lounge and round fire bowl at far short end of pool, narrow stone walkway between villa and pool, straight exterior floating wood stair on villa's near end wall up to roof, wooden bar with exactly three wicker stools on landward deck at near-right, teak rooftop with white daybed left and brass telescope right, slim dark/glass perimeter railing. No additional pools, wings or stairs. No people, no numbers or dimensions, no brands. Make a professional ARCHITECTURAL REFERENCE BOARD, portrait composition, clean white background. Two large vertically stacked precise orthographic colored elevations of this villa: top the pool-facing long elevation with glass sliding doors, palms and roof; bottom the short stair-facing elevation showing the floating wood stair meeting the roof landing and ground bar. At bottom a small row of four material close-up swatches: white plaster, teak decking, cream limestone, dark-framed glass. Crisp fine architectural ink outlines with subtle realistic material rendering, coherent scale across views. Generous margins. No written labels or text. This is concept set reference not construction drawing.
